name: GeoNatureAgent v5
protocol: GeoNatureAgent v5 fixed 93 tasks, prompt v3, 16 tools, max_turns=10, temperature=1, strict all-check success.

explanation.en: A task passes only when every required deterministic check succeeds.
explanation.zh: 只有所有必需的 deterministic check 都通过，task 才算成功。

summary.en: GeoNatureAgent evaluates tool-using agents on reproducible geoscience and natural-environment workflows.
summary.zh: GeoNatureAgent 评估 tool-using agent 完成可复现地球科学与自然环境 workflow 的能力。

task_format.en: The agent solves 93 tasks with 16 pinned tools under a ten-turn limit.
task_format.zh: agent 使用 16 个固定工具，在最多十轮内完成 93 个 task。
